description:
This shield has your own half dragon skin stretched across a lightweight frame, and is enchanted to bring out your dragon side's nature.  It doesn't slow down anyone
who equips it like a normal shield, but instead speeds them up a little, and protects them from many elements and damage.  The encyclopedia entry on this shield has more info.
name: Half Dragon Hide Shield
note:
<tjsArmor>
<cgmzdesc:
This shield features your own body's skin, tanned and oiled, stretched across a lightweight frame that makes it light yet strong, and allows anyone who equips it to move quickly while being very protected, unlike traditional shields which tend to be heavy and cumbersome.

You can't help but notice that the section of skin taken from your body must have come from your torso, including skin from your back, belly, and chest.  It has your belly button, strected out like the rest of the skin, on the front in one lower side corner, and the skin wraps around the frame so that it goes around the edges and covers much of the back of the shield as well, up to where it has a grip and a loop for putting one's forearm through it.  One spot on the skin, on the back, has one of your nipples, also stretched out.  Muscle bulges from your abdominal muscle blocks and pectorals aren't visible, as being stretched tightly over the frame has made the large piece of your skin smooth.  Overall, the entire section of your skin making up the outer part of the shield has been turned into a leather of sorts, tanned and oiled, yet left pure white in color.

This shield has been magically enchanted to enhance it's protection and more even further.  It grants a 25 percent chance of an additional attack, increases maximum hit points, speeds up and strengthens the person equipping it by increasing agility and attack scores - much like your own half dragon self, and partially negates physical and magical damage.  It also negates most fire, ice, electricity, and poison damage, as well as some mana force and Darkness based curse damage.  ("Darkness" is capitalized on purpose here, for good reason.)
>

description:
A thin, lightweight and flexible, very discreet fingerless glove made from your own skin, tanned, oiled, and dyed to be black in color.
Magically provides protection from bad stuff, and enhances attacks.
name: Half Dragon Skin Glove
note:
<tjsArmor>
<cgmzdesc:
This glove enhances attack, agility, and maximum Hit Point scores, increases attack speed a little, and also increases attack hit rate by a percentage.

You doubt you'd find anything like this glove on any common market, or from any merchant or store you would normally know how to find.
>
